title: Test coverage — new bulk discount tier with no test case

pullRequest.title: Add the bulk discount tier
pullRequest.body:
Sales agreed a bulk tier for warehouse customers: once an order reaches the parcel minimum it earns a per-parcel discount, still capped at the usual maximum. Below the minimum a bulk account prices like a standard one.

Adds "bulk" to CustomerTier and the matching branch in applyDiscount.
pullRequest.author: rmarchetti
